monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The expanded edible guide adds relevant conversion paths to the licensed-seller verifier and the site's neutral price-and-label calculator; it adds no merchant, coupon, commercial product, or affiliate link.

image_qa.note: The new and expanded guides use image-free editorial layouts, tables, worksheets, and source cards; the technical change alters form semantics only. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. Stem Cell CBG was the only supported position 4–20 content signal with meaningful volume—18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2—but that opportunity received both a material page expansion and distinct supporting coverage on October 15. No Data-led page was added today because repeating the cluster before new evidence arrives would risk cannibalization. One-impression query rows, HTTP-variant noise, four ashtray impressions, and the isolated Oklahoma-law click at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak, unstable, or irrelevant.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cannabis claim fact-check worksheet that matches claims to the exact product, source, study design, limits, conflicting evidence, and current rule; added reciprocal paths from the official-source and cancer-claims guides; and rebuilt the edible guide around a complete label-to-checkout decision record. The accessible-form audit strengthens the site's trust standard. No outreach was sent, and no marginal target was added to the qualified-opportunity log.
